service.method: SELECT TYPE , CODE , TEXT1 AS APP_TYPE_NAME1 , TEXT2 AS APP_TYPE_NAME2 , TEXT3 AS BUSINESS_SERVICE , TEXT4 AS PROGRESS_METHOD , TEXT5 AS CONFIRM_METHOD , TEXT6 AS REJECT_METHOD , TEXT7 AS WITHDRAW_METHOD , TEXT8 AS REUSE_METHOD , 'doApprovalDelete' AS DELETE_METHOD FROM SCODE with(nolock) WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND TYPE = 'AP001' AND CODE = ${APP_TYPE} AND LANGUAGE = ${session.LANGUAGE}
